calls.reason: The packet contains no independent confirmation of the $8.84 billion consolidated loss or its allocation. Reporting on operating and attributable losses does not establish this figure.

Quartz reports all four measures, with attributable loss rounded to $38.5 billion, and cites FT verification of the audited documents. The packet also notes independent reporting of rounded figures consistent with the claim.
Ars Technica and Tech Times repeat the $10.59 billion figure without separately verifying it. The FT report omits this component, and no reconciliation establishes payments versus recorded expenses.

Quartz directly reports year-end assets just above $50 billion and roughly half in cash, citing audited documents verified by the FT. That supports the statement's approximate wording, although exact balances remain unavailable.
